sources.title: README.md · FaustianDeal/Artemis-31B-v1.2-NVFP4-GGUF at main
sources.snippet: Artemis 31B v1.2 — NVFP4 GGUF This is a text-model GGUF conversion of TheDrummer/Artemis-31B-v1.2, a fine-tune of google/gemma-4-31B. The language model's eligible linear weights were calibrated and quantized to NVIDIA NVFP4, then repacked into GGUF. The original fine-tune is credited to TheDrummer; this repository contains a format and precision conversion.

sources.snippet: Artemis-31B-v1 is a 31 billion parameter model developed by TheDrummer, specifically engineered to excel in creative and entertainment-focused applications. Unlike models optimized for problem-solving or strict alignment, Artemis-31B-v1 prioritizes qualities such as writing fluency, storytelling dynamism, and imaginative capacity.
